_readme: src/data/vehicleModels.json — PRESENTATION ONLY. No prices live here.
Photos, labels, descriptions and specs for the cars a rider browses. Edit
this file and redeploy; no migration, no admin screen, no app release.
PRICES ARE DELIBERATELY ABSENT. They live in fare_configs and
rental_packages, which is what quote.service actually charges against. A
price here as well would be a second source of truth for money: the two
drift, the app shows one number, the bill says another, and nobody notices
until a customer argues. The admin sets prices in the Rate Cards screen.
EACH KEY UNDER `classes` MUST EQUAL a vehicle_catalog.key, which must equal
the vehicleClass on fare_configs. A key with no catalogue row is IGNORED by
vehicleCatalog.service — it does not create a class. A typo therefore shows
nothing rather than showing a car nobody can be quoted for.
MULTIPLE CARS PER CLASS: each key holds an ARRAY. Add as many entries as
the class has cars. They all price at the class rate, which is the point of
grouping them — a rider choosing between two white Dzires is choosing on
photographs, not on fare.
IMAGES: an array of { label, url }. Paste the url returned by
POST /api/v1/admin/vehicles/:key/images, or any https URL. `label` is shown
under the gallery — Front, Side, Rear, Interior. An empty array is fine:
the app falls back to the class glyph rather than a broken frame. Never a
local path; the app cannot resolve one.
`specs` is a short chip row. Keep each entry to two or three words.

swift-dzire.name: Maruti Swift Dzire
swift-dzire.description: Air-conditioned compact sedan. Comfortable for up to four passengers with two medium bags — the usual choice for city runs and airport transfers.

ertiga.name: Maruti Ertiga
ertiga.description: Seven-seat MPV with air conditioning. Suits a family or a small group travelling together with moderate luggage.

innova.name: Toyota Innova
innova.description: The long-serving eight-seater. Roomy and dependable, and the workhorse of outstation travel for good reason.

innova-crysta.name: Toyota Innova Crysta
innova-crysta.description: A quieter cabin and better seats than the older Innova. Worth the step up on journeys over a few hours.

innova-hycross.name: Toyota Innova Hycross
innova-hycross.description: The newest and quietest eight-seater in the fleet. Automatic and hybrid, for client travel and long tours.

tempo-12.name: Force Tempo Traveller 12
tempo-12.description: Twelve-seat air-conditioned coach for family trips, office outings and temple tours. High roof, easy to move around in.

urbania-maharaja.name: Force Urbania 1x1 Maharaja
urbania-maharaja.description: Premium coach with single-seat-either-side 1x1 recliners, so nobody shares an armrest. For weddings, VIP travel and long tours where comfort is the point.

urbania-13.name: Force Urbania 13
urbania-13.description: Thirteen-seat air-conditioned Urbania. High roof, comfortable over distance, and easy to load.

urbania-16.name: Force Urbania 16
urbania-16.description: The larger Urbania at sixteen seats, for bigger groups wanting the same comfort as the thirteen.

tempo-17.name: Force Tempo Traveller 17
tempo-17.description: Seventeen-seat air-conditioned coach, priced for full twelve-hour days out.

benz-22.name: Bharat Benz 22 Seater
benz-22.description: Air-conditioned luxury coach for corporate offsites, pilgrimages and wedding parties.

benz-28.name: Bharat Benz 28 Seater
benz-28.description: The larger Bharat Benz luxury coach, for groups approaching thirty.

benz-33.name: Bharat Benz 33 Seater
benz-33.description: The largest coach offered, in executive trim. For full-size group travel and events.

_pending_fortuner.name: Toyota Fortuner
_pending_fortuner.description: Premium SUV for outstation travel. Rename this key to `fortuner` once the vehicle_catalog row and its rate cards exist — until then it is ignored, which is why it is prefixed.

_pending_mercedes-e.name: Mercedes-Benz E-Class
_pending_mercedes-e.description: Executive saloon, chauffeur driven. Rename this key to `mercedes-e` once its catalogue row and rate cards exist.
